tutorial.welcome.en: Welcome, young leader. I am Sensei Hoshi. Our clan has found a hidden valley in the mountains. Let's build a village no rival can find.
tutorial.welcome.text: Barka da zuwa, shugaba. Ni ne Malam Hoshi. Danginmu sun sami wani kwari ɓoyayye a cikin duwatsu. Mu gina ƙauyen da babu abokin hamayya da zai iya gano shi.

tutorial.mint.collect.en: Your Coin Mint is striking Coins. When a coin floats over it, tap it, then Collect.
tutorial.mint.collect.text: Masana'antar Kuɗinku tana ƙera Kuɗi. Idan tsaba ta bayyana a samanta, ku taɓa ta, sannan Karɓa.

tutorial.mint.build.en: A clan runs on Coins. Tap Build and place a Coin Mint.
tutorial.mint.build.text: Dangi na tafiya ne da Kuɗi. Ku taɓa Gina ku sanya Masana'antar Kuɗi.

tutorial.keep.en: Now strengthen the Clan Keep: tap the castle, then Upgrade.
tutorial.keep.text: Yanzu ku ƙarfafa Fadar Dangi: ku taɓa gidan sarauta, sannan Inganta.

tutorial.finishKeep.wait.en: Upgrades take time. The Keep is ready in {time}: come back then, or tap Finish now to use a little Jade.
tutorial.finishKeep.wait.text: Ingantawa na ɗaukar lokaci. Fada za ta kammala cikin {time}: ku dawo a lokacin, ko ku taɓa Gama yanzu don amfani da ɗan Jed.

tutorial.finishKeep.done.en: The Keep is ready. Well done!

tutorial.army.tower.en: Rival clans will raid us. Build a Kunai Tower next to the Keep (Build, then the Defense tab): it shoots any raider in range.
tutorial.army.tower.text: Dangogin abokan hamayya za su kawo mana hari. Ku gina Hasumiyar Kunai kusa da Fada (Gina, sannan shafin Tsaro): tana harbin duk mai kai hari da ke kusa.

tutorial.army.all.en: Build a Training Dojo, a Squad Courtyard and a Kunai Tower next to the Keep (Build: the Army tab, then the Defense tab).
tutorial.army.all.text: Ku gina Dojon Horo, Farfajiyar Tawaga da Hasumiyar Kunai kusa da Fada (Gina: shafin Runduna, sannan shafin Tsaro).

tutorial.train.en: Open the Army panel and train some Shinobi: fast blades that strike the nearest building.
tutorial.train.text: Ku buɗe allon Runduna ku horar da wasu Shinobi: masu takobi masu sauri da ke sara ginin da ya fi kusa.

tutorial.finishTrain.wait.en: Training takes time too: your warriors are ready in {time}. Wait, or tap Finish training to use a little Jade.
tutorial.finishTrain.wait.text: Horo ma na ɗaukar lokaci: mayaƙanku za su shirya cikin {time}. Ku jira, ko ku taɓa Gama horo don amfani da ɗan Jed.

tutorial.raid.en: Your first raid. Tap Attack, look over the target, then Attack! On the battlefield I will show you one thing at a time: send your Shinobi in through a glowing point, then smoke them as they reach a tower: warriors inside the smoke can only be shot from close up.
tutorial.raid.text: Harinku na farko. Ku taɓa Kai hari, ku duba abin da za ku kai wa hari, sannan Kai hari! A filin daga zan nuna muku abu ɗaya bayan ɗaya: ku tura Shinobi ta wani wuri mai haske, sannan ku rufe su da hayaƙi idan sun isa hasumiya: mayaƙan da ke cikin hayaƙi ba a iya harbinsu sai daga kusa.

tutorial.end.en: Well fought. Raids fill your storage fast: upgrade the Clan Keep (or a storage) next. Then upgrade the Training Dojo to unlock Saboteurs: they jam a defense for a few seconds. Jam first, then strike, and smoke your warriors where the fire is heaviest. Collect, upgrade, raid, and join an Alliance.
tutorial.end.text: An yi yaƙi da kyau. Hare-hare suna cika rumbunanku da sauri: ku inganta Fadar Dangi (ko wani rumbu) a gaba. Sannan ku inganta Dojon Horo don buɗe Masu Zagon Ƙasa: suna tsayar da ginin tsaro na ƴan daƙiƙoƙi. Ku fara tsayarwa, sannan ku kai bugu, ku rufe mayaƙanku da hayaƙi inda wuta ta fi zafi. Ku karɓa, ku inganta, ku kai hari, ku shiga Ƙawance.

whatsNew.0_1_0.en: What's new: send your squad in with one order, watch the fight up close or faster, and see what another entry point would have done. Every raid on your village now has a report, and you can test your defenses. New: a four-week event calendar with festivals, a weekly Gauntlet, daily contracts, achievements, Keep seals and looks to earn.
whatsNew.0_1_0.text: Sabbin abubuwa: ku tura tawagarku da umarni ɗaya, ku kalli faɗa daga kusa ko da sauri, ku kuma ga yadda zai kasance da kun shiga ta wani wurin kutse. Yanzu kowane hari kan ƙauyenku yana da rahoto, kuma kuna iya gwada tsaronku. Sabo: kalandar abubuwan wasa ta makonni huɗu tare da bukukuwa, Babban Ƙalubale na mako-mako, kwangilar yau da kullum, nasarori, hatiman Fada da kamanni da za ku samu.

codex.rivalsRule.en: Computer rival clans read your last {n, plural, one {# raid} other {# raids}}: about {pct} of their outposts are tempered against the warriors you used most.
codex.rivalsRule.text: Dangogin abokan hamayya na kwamfuta suna duba {n, plural, one {harinku na ƙarshe} other {hare-harenku # na ƙarshe}}: kusan {pct} na sansanoninsu na waje an tsara su don yaƙar mayaƙan da kuka fi amfani da su.

codex.exhaustionRule.en: For {hours, plural, one {# hour} other {# hours}} after each raid your village loses, the next raider can take only {pct} as much (two losses multiply).
codex.exhaustionRule.text: Na tsawon {hours, plural, one {awa #} other {awa #}} bayan kowane hari da ƙauyenku ya sha kaye, mai kai hari na gaba zai iya ɗaukar {pct} kawai na abin da aka saba (kaye biyu suna ninkuwa).

codex.temperRule.en: From Clan Keep {level}, defenses can be tempered: Reach shoots farther but softer, Blast hits groups but fires slower, Watch strengthens air defense and traps. Each rival clan leans one way:
codex.temperRule.text: Daga Fadar Dangi mataki {level}, ana iya tsara gine-ginen tsaro: Nisa yana harbi nesa amma da ƙarancin ƙarfi, Fashewa yana bugun gungun mayaƙa amma yana harbi a hankali, Tsaro yana ƙarfafa kariya ta sama da tarkuna. Kowane dangin abokan hamayya yana karkata zuwa hanya ɗaya:

codex.counters.text: {building} na aiki kan {list} (an gwada a yaƙi).

builders.crewNote.en: The garrison crew builds defenses, traps and support counters without taking a Village Artisan.
builders.crewNote.text: Ma'aikatan sansani suna gina gine-ginen tsaro, tarkuna da gine-ginen tallafi ba tare da ɗaukar Maginin Ƙauye ba.

calendar.about.en: One reward a day, the same for everyone, never random and never sold. Miss a day and nothing is lost: the next claim is the next day on the list. Day 28 gives a Keep look.
calendar.about.text: Lada ɗaya a kowace rana, iri ɗaya ga kowa, ba na sa'a ba kuma ba a sayar da shi. Idan kun rasa wata rana babu abin da zai ɓace: karɓa ta gaba ita ce rana ta gaba a jerin. Rana ta 28 tana ba da kamannin Fada.

calendar.gotLook.text: Sabon kamannin Fada naku ne: Shago → Kamanni.

offers.minor.text: Tayi na musamman ba sa fitowa ga ƴan wasa ƴan ƙasa da shekara 18. Duk abin da ke shafin Jed yana nan a cikin iyakar kashe kuɗinku.

store.withdrawalStipend.en: Delivery starts at once: the first payment can be claimed now and one more each day; by buying you agree that you lose the right to cancel, as the law allows for digital content.
store.withdrawalStipend.text: Isarwa tana farawa nan take: ana iya karɓar biya na farko yanzu, ɗaya kuma a kowace rana; ta hanyar saya kun yarda cewa kun rasa damar soke sayen, kamar yadda doka ta ba da dama ga abubuwan dijital.

raid.reportPending.en: Your last raid is still being sent to the server. Try again in a moment; Practice and Trials still work.

save.restoredPrevious.en: Your latest save could not be read, so an earlier copy ({when}) was loaded.

save.openFailed.title.text: Ba a iya buɗe ƙauyenku ba

save.openFailed.body.text: Wannan na'urar ba ta buɗe ƙauyenku da aka adana a kan lokaci ba. Ku sake gwadawa, ko ku yi wasa da ƙauye na wucin gadi a yanzu: ba a adana shi kuma yana nan ba tare da intanet ba.

save.openFailed.temporary.text: Yi wasa da ƙauye na wucin gadi

store.error.unavailable.en: Purchases are not available right now. Try again later.
store.error.unavailable.text: Ba a iya saya a yanzu. Ku sake gwadawa nan gaba.

store.error.failed.en: The purchase did not go through. If you were charged, it is delivered as soon as the store confirms it.
store.error.failed.text: Sayayyar ba ta yi nasara ba. Idan an cire muku kuɗi, za a isar da ita da zarar shagon ya tabbatar.

raid.rejected.expiredAt.en: Its report (from the raid on {date}) reached the server after the 72-hour limit.

raid.rejected.defender_protected.text: Wannan ƙauyen yana da garkuwa tun kafin nan.

raid.rejected.no_warriors.en: No warriors fought, so it counts as practice.
raid.rejected.no_warriors.text: Babu mayaƙin da ya yi yaƙi, don haka an ɗauke shi a matsayin atisaye.

temper.intro.en: Shape every {building} at once. Reach shoots farther but hits softer and goes for back-line warriors first; Blast hits groups but fires slower; Watch makes the Sky Bow Tower, the Bitter Smoke Brazier and traps stronger. Raiders see the shape when they scout.
temper.intro.text: Ku tsara kowane gini na {building} lokaci ɗaya. Nisa yana harbi mai nisa amma da ƙarancin ƙarfi kuma yana fara kai wa mayaƙan baya; Fashewa yana bugun gungun mayaƙa amma yana harbi a hankali; Tsaro yana ƙara ƙarfin Hasumiyar Bakan Sama, Kaskon Hayaƙi Mai Ɗaci da tarkuna. Masu kai hari suna ganin tsarin idan sun yi leƙen asiri.

temper.watchSupport.en: Watch also weakens the raiders' healing, revives, toughness and shield cover across the whole base.
temper.watchSupport.text: Tsaro yana kuma raunana warkarwa, rayarwa, ƙarfin jure wa da kariyar garkuwa ta maharan a duk sansanin.

stake.help.en: Declare a result before you attack: reach it and carry more loot home, miss it and carry none.
stake.help.text: Ku bayyana sakamako kafin ku kai hari: idan kun kai shi za ku kawo ƙarin ganima gida, idan kun kasa ba za ku kawo komai ba.

stake.met.text: An cika alƙawari: {stars}★ ya kawo ganima ×{mult}.

stake.missed.en: Stake missed: you declared {stars}★, so no loot came home.
stake.missed.text: An kasa cika alƙawari: kun bayyana {stars}★, don haka babu ganimar da ta dawo gida.

account.signOutDevice.note.en: Finished playing on this phone or browser? Sign it out. Your online account stays for your other devices and linked sign-ins.
account.signOutDevice.note.text: Kun gama wasa a wannan waya ko burauza? Ku fita daga ciki. Asusunku na intanet yana nan don sauran na'urorinku da hanyoyin shiga da aka haɗa.

account.signOutDevice.body.en: Online play turns off here and this device forgets its key to your online account. The village on this device stays. To play the account here again, sign in with a linked Apple, Google or Game Center account.
account.signOutDevice.body.text: Wasa ta intanet zai kashe a nan kuma wannan na'urar za ta manta mabuɗinta na asusunku na intanet. Ƙauyen da ke wannan na'urar yana nan. Don sake buga asusun a nan, ku shiga da asusun Apple, Google ko Game Center da aka haɗa.

account.signOutDevice.done.en: This device is signed out. Online play is off here.
account.signOutDevice.done.text: An fita daga wannan na'urar. Wasa ta intanet ya kashe a nan.

account.signOutDevice.pending.en: Not signed out yet: some of your play is still being sent (actions: {actions}, battle reports: {raids}). Try again when the connection is better.
account.signOutDevice.pending.text: Ba a fita ba tukuna: wani ɓangare na wasanku har yanzu ana aika shi (ayyuka: {actions}, rahotannin yaƙi: {raids}). Ku sake gwadawa idan haɗin intanet ya inganta.

account.signOutDevice.lastKey.en: Not signed out: this device holds the only key to your online account. Link Apple, Google or Game Center first, or delete the account instead.
account.signOutDevice.lastKey.text: Ba a fita ba: wannan na'urar ce kaɗai ke riƙe da mabuɗin asusunku na intanet. Ku fara haɗa Apple, Google ko Game Center, ko ku goge asusun maimakon haka.

news.reason.resources.en: There were not enough resources in your village on the server.
news.reason.resources.text: Babu isassun albarkatu a ƙauyenku da ke sabar.

news.reason.builder.text: Babu Maginin Ƙauye da ke hutawa.

news.reason.maxLevel.en: It was already at its highest level.
news.reason.maxLevel.text: Ya riga ya kai matakinsa mafi girma.

news.reason.gone.en: It was no longer in your village.

news.reason.busy.en: It was already being worked on.
news.reason.busy.text: Ana riga ana aiki a kansa.

news.reason.limit.en: The limit for it was already reached.

news.reason.locked.text: Ba a buɗe shi ba tukuna.

news.reason.changed.en: Your village had already changed, for example on another device.
news.reason.changed.text: Ƙauyenku ya riga ya canza, misali a wata na'ura.

refusal.storageFullRefund.en: Storage is too full: cancelling now would lose {lost} of the {refund} you would get back. Make room first.
refusal.storageFullRefund.text: Rumbuna sun cika sosai: soke yanzu zai sa a rasa {lost} daga cikin {refund} da za a mayar muku. Ku fara samar da sarari.

league.boardOnline.en: The leaderboards are part of online play.
league.boardOnline.text: Jerin gwaraza wani ɓangare ne na wasa ta intanet.

sheet.raidRule.en: Raiders can take {pct} of what your storages hold, never more than {cap} of each resource while your Keep is level {level}, and {collectors} of what your collectors have not collected yet.
sheet.raidRule.text: Masu kai hari na iya ɗaukar {pct} na abin da ke cikin rumbunanku, kada ya wuce {cap} na kowane albarkatu yayin da Fadarku ke mataki {level}, da {collectors} na abin da ke cikin masu tarawarku da ba a karɓa ba tukuna.

sheet.collectorPause.en: It produces nothing while it upgrades ({time}). What it holds now stays and can still be collected.
sheet.collectorPause.text: Ba ya samar da komai yayin da ake inganta shi ({time}). Abin da ke cikinsa yanzu yana nan kuma har yanzu ana iya karɓa.

unlock.title.en: {n, plural, one {New warrior unlocked!} other {New warriors unlocked!}}
unlock.title.text: {n, plural, one {An buɗe sabon mayaƙi!} other {An buɗe sababbin mayaƙa!}}

keep.armyBehind.en: Your warriors' training is more than a Keep behind your village: a higher Keep meets stronger rivals and raiders. Research or train first?
keep.armyBehind.text: Horon mayaƙanku ya yi baya da ƙauyenku fiye da mataki ɗaya na Fada: Fada mafi girma tana haɗa ku da abokan hamayya da masu kai hari mafi ƙarfi. Bincike ko horo tukuna?

scout.lootWontFit.en: Your storage cannot hold all the loot on offer: what does not fit is lost.
scout.lootWontFit.text: Rumbunanku ba za su iya ɗaukar duk ganimar da ke akwai ba: abin da bai shiga ba zai ɓace.

trials.caughtUp.en: Tiers {from} to {to} are counted as cleared too, each paid once.
trials.caughtUp.text: An ƙidaya matakai {from} zuwa {to} a matsayin waɗanda aka wuce su ma, ana biyan kowanne sau ɗaya.

drill.title.text: Atisayen kullum (gwaji: ba a kashe komai ba)

drill.about.en: Daily drill: fight this fortress with a full camp of your own warriors. Nothing is spent, and today's first drill pays a small reward.
drill.about.text: Atisayen kullum: ku yaƙi wannan sansani da cikakkiyar rundunar mayaƙanku. Ba a kashe komai ba, kuma atisayen farko na yau yana ba da ƙaramin lada.

drill.paid.en: Drill done: today's reward is paid. Nothing was spent.
drill.paid.text: An gama atisaye: an biya ladan yau. Ba a kashe komai ba.

drill.doneToday.en: Today's drill reward is already paid. You can still drill for practice; the next reward comes tomorrow.
drill.doneToday.text: An riga an biya ladan atisayen yau. Kuna iya ci gaba da atisaye don gwaji; lada na gaba zai zo gobe.

scout.shieldEnds.en: Your shield has {time} left: attacking ends it.
scout.shieldEnds.text: Saura {time} a garkuwarku: kai hari zai kawo ƙarshenta.

tutorial.end.daily.en: Your first daily chest is ready: Finish opens it.
tutorial.end.daily.text: Akwatinku na farko na yau da kullum ya shirya: Gama zai buɗe shi.

panel.loadFailed.en: This could not open. Check your connection and try again.
panel.loadFailed.text: Ba a iya buɗe wannan ba. Ku duba haɗin intanet ɗinku ku sake gwadawa.

panel.staleChunk.en: A newer version of Kagemura is out. Reload to open this.
panel.staleChunk.text: Sabuwar sigar Kagemura ta fito. Ku sake lodawa don buɗe wannan.

quality.slowBattles.en: This phone drew battles slowly, so Kagemura will use lighter graphics from the next start. You can change it in Settings → Graphics.
quality.slowBattles.text: Wannan waya ta zana yaƙe-yaƙe a hankali, don haka Kagemura zai yi amfani da hotuna masu sauƙi daga farawa ta gaba. Kuna iya canza shi a Saituna → Hotuna.

events.calendar.server.en: Schedule sent by the game's server. Every countdown is real.
events.calendar.server.text: Jadawalin da sabar wasan ta aiko. Kowane ƙidayar lokaci gaskiya ce.

events.calendar.builtIn.en: Built-in schedule. Every countdown is real.
events.calendar.builtIn.text: Jadawali na cikin wasa. Kowane ƙidayar lokaci gaskiya ce.

events.fixed.en: Events follow a fixed calendar: a four-week cycle plus five festivals on fixed dates each year. Their times never move or get extended, so the countdown is always the real one.
events.fixed.text: Bukukuwa suna bin kalanda tsayayye: zagayen mako huɗu tare da bukukuwan shekara biyar a ranaku tsayayyu kowace shekara. Lokutansu ba sa canzawa ko ƙaruwa, don haka ƙidayar lokaci koyaushe gaskiya ce.

contract.about.en: The same for everyone today; a new one in {time}. It changes only what a won raid carries home.
contract.about.text: Iri ɗaya ce ga kowa a yau; sabuwa cikin {time}. Tana canza abin da harin da aka ci ke kawowa gida ne kawai.

events.gauntlet.attack.text: Kai hari kan sansanin Babban Ƙalubale

events.gauntlet.about.en: A computer-made fortress, the same base for everyone at your Keep this week. No loot inside; each star mark on the ladder pays once.
events.gauntlet.about.text: Sansanin da kwamfuta ta yi, iri ɗaya ga duk ƴan wasan da ke matakin Fadarku a wannan mako. Babu ganima a ciki; kowace alamar tauraro a kan tsani tana biya sau ɗaya.

events.festival.about.en: A computer-made fortress at your Keep, the same for every attempt. No loot inside; each mark on the ladder pays once, and three stars give the festival's look.
events.festival.about.text: Sansanin da kwamfuta ta yi a matakin Fadarku, iri ɗaya a kowane gwaji. Babu ganima a ciki; kowace alama a kan tsani tana biya sau ɗaya, kuma taurari uku suna ba da kamannin bikin.

growth.invite.rule.en: When a friend who started with your friend code reaches Keep {keep} with their village on the server, you each get a fixed reward. Nothing random and nothing to buy.
growth.invite.rule.text: Idan abokin da ya fara da lambar abotarku ya kai Fada {keep} tare da ƙauyensa a sabar, kowannenku zai sami ƙayyadadden lada. Babu abin bazata kuma babu abin saya.

growth.invite.reward.en: Reward for each of you: {jade} Jade

growth.invite.cap.en: {cap, plural, one {Rewards for up to # friend a month.} other {Rewards for up to # friends a month.}}
growth.invite.cap.text: {cap, plural, one {Lada don aboki har # a wata.} other {Lada don abokai har # a wata.}}

growth.invite.counts.en: Friends who joined with your code: waiting {waiting}, ready {ready}, rewarded {rewarded}
growth.invite.counts.text: Abokan da suka shiga da lambarku: suna jira {waiting}, sun shirya {ready}, an ba su lada {rewarded}

growth.invite.mine.waiting.en: You joined with a friend's code. Reach Keep {keep} with your village on the server and you both get the reward.
growth.invite.mine.waiting.text: Kun shiga da lambar aboki. Ku kai Fada {keep} tare da ƙauyenku a sabar kuma ku biyu za ku sami ladan.

growth.invite.mine.ready.en: You joined with a friend's code and reached Keep {keep}: your reward is ready.
growth.invite.mine.ready.text: Kun shiga da lambar aboki kuma kun kai Fada {keep}: ladanku ya shirya.

growth.invite.mine.rewarded.en: You joined with a friend's code and collected your reward.
growth.invite.mine.rewarded.text: Kun shiga da lambar aboki kuma kun karɓi ladanku.

growth.invite.needsServer.en: Rewards go to a village on the server. Move your village there in Settings → Online play.
growth.invite.needsServer.text: Lada yana zuwa ga ƙauye da ke sabar. Ku mayar da ƙauyenku can a Saituna → Wasa ta intanet.

growth.invite.adultsOnly.en: Friend invite rewards are for adults only. You can still add friends and play together.
growth.invite.adultsOnly.text: Ladan gayyatar abokai na manya ne kaɗai. Har yanzu kuna iya ƙara abokai ku yi wasa tare.

growth.invite.enterTitle.text: Shin wani aboki ya gayyace ku?

growth.invite.enterHint.en: {days, plural, one {Enter their friend code within # day of starting online play.} other {Enter their friend code within # days of starting online play.}}
growth.invite.enterHint.text: {days, plural, one {Ku shigar da lambar abotar abokinku cikin kwana # da fara wasa ta intanet.} other {Ku shigar da lambar abotar abokinku cikin kwanaki # da fara wasa ta intanet.}}

growth.share.explain.en: {days, plural, one {The server checks this replay and keeps it for # day under a code. Anyone with the link can watch it. The base is shown without its name and your opponent is never named.} other {The server checks this replay and keeps it for # days under a code. Anyone with the link can watch it. The base is shown without its name and your opponent is never named.}}
growth.share.explain.text: {days, plural, one {Sabar tana duba wannan maimaici kuma tana ajiye shi na kwana # ƙarƙashin wata lamba. Duk wanda ke da mahaɗin zai iya kallo. Ana nuna sansanin ba tare da sunansa ba kuma ba a taɓa ambaton abokin hamayyarku ba.} other {Sabar tana duba wannan maimaici kuma tana ajiye shi na kwanaki # ƙarƙashin wata lamba. Duk wanda ke da mahaɗin zai iya kallo. Ana nuna sansanin ba tare da sunansa ba kuma ba a taɓa ambaton abokin hamayyarku ba.}}

growth.share.minor.en: Your name is not shown on replays shared by players under 18.
growth.share.minor.text: Ba a nuna sunanku a maimaicin da ƴan wasa ƴan ƙasa da shekara 18 suka raba.

growth.viewer.anon.text: Wani ɗan wasa ne ya raba

growth.viewer.player.text: Kan sansanin ɗan wasa na gaske.

growth.viewer.generated.en: Against a generated base (made by the computer).
growth.viewer.generated.text: Kan sansanin da kwamfuta ta ƙirƙira.

growth.viewer.failed.en: This shared replay could not be opened.
growth.viewer.failed.text: Ba a iya buɗe wannan maimaicin da aka raba ba.

growth.viewer.older.en: This replay was recorded under other battle rules, so this version of the game cannot show it.
growth.viewer.older.text: An naɗi wannan maimaici ƙarƙashin wasu dokokin yaƙi, don haka wannan sigar wasan ba za ta iya nuna shi ba.

alliance.banner.next.text: Tuta ta gaba a matakin Ƙawance {level}.

alliance.banner.note.en: Banners only change how the Alliance looks: no advantage in battle or resources.
alliance.banner.note.text: Tutoci suna canza kamannin Ƙawance ne kawai: babu fifiko a yaƙi ko albarkatu.

stats.tzNote.en: It also sends your time zone's offset from UTC, so days are counted on your own calendar.
stats.tzNote.text: Yana kuma aika bambancin yankin lokacinku da UTC, don a ƙirga kwanaki a kalandarku.

preview.notLive.en: Preview: this is not in the live game yet.
preview.notLive.text: Samfoti: wannan ba ya cikin wasan na gaske tukuna.

heroPick.intro.en: Choose the hero who joins your attacks.
heroPick.intro.text: Ku zaɓi gwarzon da zai shiga hare-harenku.

heroPick.none.en: No hero can join yet. Heroes join from higher Keep levels.
heroPick.none.text: Babu gwarzon da zai iya shiga tukuna. Gwaraza suna shiga daga matakan Fada masu girma.

mastery.none.en: Attack with your warriors to earn mastery.
mastery.none.text: Ku kai hari da mayaƙanku don samun ƙwarewa.

seal.progress.en: Keep seal: {total, plural, one {{n} of # building} other {{n} of # buildings}} at this Keep's cap. A full Keep earns its seal.
seal.progress.text: Hatimin Fada: {total, plural, one {gini {n} cikin # ya kai} other {gine-gine {n} cikin # sun kai}} iyakar wannan Fada. Cikakkiyar Fada tana samun hatiminta.

chat.presetOnly.text: Jimlolin da aka shirya kaɗai ake nunawa.

terms.body.en: The terms of service for Kagemura came into force on {date}. Please read them and accept them to play online. Your village keeps working on this device either way.
terms.body.text: Sharuɗɗan sabis na Kagemura sun fara aiki a ranar {date}. Don Allah ku karanta su kuma ku amince da su don yin wasa ta intanet. Ƙauyenku zai ci gaba da aiki a wannan na'urar ko ta yaya.

consent.apple.label.en: Help Apple decide refund requests (off until you turn it on)
consent.apple.label.text: Taimaka wa Apple ya yanke shawara kan buƙatun mayar da kuɗi (a kashe har sai kun kunna)

consent.apple.detail.en: When you ask Apple for a refund, Apple may ask us about the purchase. With this on, we tell Apple that it was delivered and give ranges for how old your account is and how much you have bought and been refunded. Never your name, village or chat. We never ask Apple to refuse a refund.
consent.apple.detail.text: Idan kun nemi Apple ya mayar muku da kuɗi, Apple na iya tambayar mu game da sayayyar. Idan wannan yana kunne, muna gaya wa Apple cewa an isar da ita kuma muna ba da kimanin tsawon shekarun asusunku da yawan abin da kuka saya da wanda aka mayar muku. Ba sunanku, ƙauyenku ko hirarku ba. Ba ma taɓa roƙon Apple ya ƙi mayar da kuɗi.

replays.allowBase.label.en: Allow my base in other players' shared replays
replays.allowBase.label.text: Bari sansanina ya bayyana a maimaicin da sauran ƴan wasa suka raba

replays.allowBase.detail.en: When someone shares a replay of a raid on your village, it shows your base layout (never your name). Turn this off and your base is never shown, and shares already made of it are removed.
replays.allowBase.detail.text: Idan wani ya raba maimaicin harin da aka kai wa ƙauyenku, yana nuna tsarin sansaninku (ba sunanku ba). Ku kashe wannan kuma ba za a taɓa nuna sansaninku ba, kuma za a cire maimaicin da aka riga aka raba da ke nuna shi.

significantUpdate.description.en: This update changes how Kagemura works. A parent or guardian can review it before it is used.
significantUpdate.description.text: Wannan sabuntawa yana canza yadda Kagemura ke aiki. Iyaye ko mai kula na iya duba shi kafin a yi amfani da shi.

season.recap.en: League at season end: {league}. Raids won: {raids}. Stars: {stars}. Scroll tiers: {tiers}.
season.recap.text: Rukuni a ƙarshen kaka: {league}. Hare-haren da aka ci: {raids}. Taurari: {stars}. Matakan Takarda: {tiers}.

welcome.scrollEnded.en: The Season Scroll ended, and the rewards you had not claimed were added:
welcome.scrollEnded.text: Takardar Kaka ta ƙare, kuma an ƙara ladan da ba ku karɓa ba:

pass.bonus.detail.en: {left, plural, =0 {All {max} bonuses collected this season ({got} of {max})} one {Every task still pays: the next bonus in # point ({got} of {max} this season)} other {Every task still pays: the next bonus in # points ({got} of {max} this season)}}
pass.bonus.detail.text: {left, plural, =0 {An karɓi duk ƙari {max} na wannan kaka ({got} cikin {max})} one {Kowane aiki yana ci gaba da ba da lada: ƙari na gaba saura maki # ({got} cikin {max} a wannan kaka)} other {Kowane aiki yana ci gaba da ba da lada: ƙari na gaba saura maki # ({got} cikin {max} a wannan kaka)}}

stake.recentHits.en: {raids, plural, one {Your last raid:} other {Your last # raids:}} 2★ or more in {two}, 3★ in {three}.
stake.recentHits.text: {raids, plural, one {Harinku na ƙarshe:} other {Hare-harenku # na ƙarshe:}} 2★ ko fiye a {two}, 3★ a {three}.

whatsNew.0_2_0.en: What's new: choose a larger text size, and turn screen shake and flashes down, in Settings. The stake picker shows how often your recent raids reached two and three stars. Shadow Trials climb more evenly, and raids at Keep 4 and Keep 15 meet fairer opponents.
whatsNew.0_2_0.text: Sabbin abubuwa: zaɓi babban girman rubutu, ka rage girgizar allo da walƙiya a Saiti. Mai zaɓen caca yana nuna sau nawa hare-harenka na kwanan nan suka kai taurari biyu da uku. Gwaje-gwajen Inuwa suna hawa daidai-wa-daida, kuma hare-hare a Kagara 4 da 15 suna samun abokan hamayya masu adalci.
